title: A Recursive Measure of Voting Power that Satisfies Reasonable Postulates
reasoning: The paper's primary goal is to design a measure of voting power and justify it by demonstrating that it satisfies a set of 'reasonable postulates'. These postulates (e.g., dummy, dominance, donation, quarrel) function as normative or ethical axioms that any fair and logical measure of power should adhere to. The work is therefore a normative project within political theory, focused on establishing an ethically and logically justified framework for measuring a social concept.
